runs.title_zh: Weekly #5 · VRAM Reclaim / Recovery Escalation / Structured RAS
runs.title_en: Weekly #5 · VRAM Reclaim / Recovery Escalation / Structured RAS
runs.intro_zh: 本期七大 Owner 不变。Memory 保持 recoverable fault/HMM 为 P0，但把 VRAM Pressure + Reclaim/Eviction 正式提升为下一阶段 P1；RAS 从 Recovery Admission/State/Sequence 扩展到 Recovery Scope + Escalation；Virtualization、Observability、Firmware 分别强化 migration-state、stable error schema 与 authoritative protocol state。
runs.intro_en: The seven-owner taxonomy stays unchanged. Memory keeps recoverable fault/HMM as P0 while promoting VRAM Pressure + Reclaim/Eviction to P1; RAS expands into Recovery Scope + Escalation; Virtualization, Observability and Firmware strengthen migration-state, stable error schemas and authoritative protocol state.

highlights.title_zh: Memory：VRAM Pressure + Reclaim/Eviction 成为下一阶段明确 Feature
highlights.title_en: Memory: VRAM Pressure + Reclaim/Eviction becomes the next explicit feature
highlights.body_zh: Linux DMEM/TTM/IGT 已把 device-memory accounting、protection、reclaim 与 eviction 测试推进到工程可验证阶段。建议 fault/HMM 第一版稳定后，复用同一 residency/migration/PTE/TLB/generation primitive 构建 reclaim 闭环。
highlights.body_en: Linux DMEM/TTM/IGT makes device-memory accounting, protection, reclaim and eviction engineering-verifiable. After fault/HMM stabilizes, reuse the same residency/migration/PTE/TLB/generation primitives for reclaim.

highlights.title_zh: RAS：Recovery Scope + Escalation 从 engine 延伸到 cold reset
highlights.title_en: RAS: Recovery Scope + Escalation extends from engines to cold reset
highlights.body_zh: Xe cold-reset recovery 说明恢复不再只是一个 reset bool，需要 context/queue/engine/FW/device/PCI/cold-reset/permanent-failure 的层级、升级条件、generation 与 userspace 协作语义。
highlights.body_en: Xe cold-reset recovery shows recovery needs explicit context/queue/engine/FW/device/PCI/cold-reset/permanent-failure levels, escalation conditions, generations and userspace cooperation.

highlights.title_zh: Virtualization：multi-queue VF migration 强化 state serialization boundary
highlights.title_en: Virtualization: multi-queue VF migration strengthens state-serialization boundaries
highlights.body_zh: PF/VF 资源从一开始就应具有 stable logical ID、reset 语义和 serialize/restore boundary；queue-group、FW scheduler、VRAM 与 VM state 都可能参与迁移。
highlights.body_en: PF/VF resources should have stable logical IDs, reset semantics and serialize/restore boundaries from the beginning; queue groups, FW scheduler, VRAM and VM state may all participate in migration.

highlights.title_zh: Observability / Firmware：稳定 error identity + authoritative protocol state
highlights.title_en: Observability / Firmware: stable error identity + authoritative protocol state
highlights.body_zh: DRM_RAS common event/threshold 与 Xe mailbox PHASE 修复分别强化两个长期原则：错误事件需要稳定 schema；共享 mailbox/ring 协议字段需要唯一 truth source。
highlights.body_en: DRM_RAS events/thresholds and the Xe mailbox-PHASE fix reinforce two durable rules: errors need a stable schema and shared mailbox/ring protocol state needs one authoritative truth source.

runs.title_zh: Weekly #4 · Recovery Contract / VFIO AER / Telemetry Service
runs.title_en: Weekly #4 · Recovery Contract / VFIO AER / Telemetry Service
runs.intro_zh: RAS 从 reset gate 深化为通用 Recovery Admission / State / Sequence Contract；VFIO PCI recovery 和 Xe PMT 分别强化 VMM-visible recovery 与 Telemetry Service/FW readiness。
runs.intro_en: RAS deepens the reset gate into a reusable Recovery Admission / State / Sequence Contract, while VFIO PCI recovery and Xe PMT strengthen VMM-visible recovery and Telemetry Service/FW readiness.

highlights.body_zh: 恢复期间关闭 admission、drain、推进 sequence、恢复后 publish NORMAL/FAILED，供 Memory/Firmware/Virtualization 共用。
highlights.body_en: Close admission, drain users, advance the sequence and publish NORMAL/FAILED after recovery for Memory/Firmware/Virtualization consumers.

highlights.body_zh: Xe PMT 强化 telemetry 的 PM lifetime、FW readiness、shared-window arbitration 与 VF privilege boundary。
highlights.body_en: Xe PMT strengthens telemetry PM lifetime, FW readiness, shared-window arbitration and VF privilege boundaries.

runs.title_zh: Weekly #3 · Fabric / Remote Invalidation / Stable FW ABI
runs.title_en: Weekly #3 · Fabric / Remote Invalidation / Stable FW ABI
runs.intro_zh: DRM Fabric + AMD UALink 把 Multi-GPU 推进到 endpoint/port/peer 与 remote-memory control；Nova r000 强化 raw FW ABI translation/validation。
runs.intro_en: DRM Fabric + AMD UALink move Multi-GPU toward endpoint/port/peer and remote-memory control, while Nova r000 strengthens raw-FW-ABI translation/validation.

highlights.body_zh: 从 GPU×GPU bool matrix 升级到 endpoint/port/peer、directional capability、link state 和 generation。
highlights.body_en: Move beyond a GPU×GPU boolean matrix toward endpoint/port/peer, directional capabilities, link state and generations.
